summary: Agent assisted customer with failed NEFT transfer.

intents.keywords: नमस्ते मैं प्रियंका राठौर मेरे खाते में नेफ्ट ट्रांसफर ...किया था
intents.actions of agent: Agent checked the transfer details and identified the incorrect IFSC code as the reason for failure. Agent offered to reinitiate the transfer once the correct IFSC code is provided.
intents.Process Request: Reinitiate NEFT transfer after customer provides correct IFSC code.
intents.resolution: Customer needs to provide the correct IFSC code to reinitiate the NEFT transfer.
